name: Raise the payments-api AI-credit budget to $2,500/month (FinOps escalation)
description: An engineering manager raises an existing $800 repository budget to $2,500. The amount crosses the $1,000 escalation threshold, so both a Copilot administrator and a FinOps approver must approve. The requestor's own `.approve` is rejected (no self-approval), and the budget is updated in place through the budgets REST API.

budget_enforcement: Stop usage when the budget is reached
values.budget_justification: The payments team moved PCI evidence collection and ledger reconciliation refactors to Copilot agent mode and the cloud agent in August. The repository hit its $800 budget on the 19th and usage was blocked for two days. Q3 forecast from the ROI report: ~$2,100/month.

selected: I understand spend up to this amount is billed to CoolEngEnt and charged back to the cost center above
My manager is aware of this request

steps.note: The issue form applies the `issueops` and `issueops:copilot-budget` labels; `issue-opened.yml` parses, validates and summarizes.
Self-approval is refused even though the requestor is an engineering manager.

steps.body: .approve Fits the Q3 envelope for CC-4410.
